summary: Iteration 3 full backend + frontend E2E. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass in test_iteration3.py (auth/no-auth on /api/overdue-nudge/run returning {triggered, nudge_count}; /api/cron/overdue-nudge: 401 without Bearer, 401 with wrong Bearer, 200 {accepted:true} with correct WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET; /api/collections returns {total_outstanding, shops_with_dues, total_paid, rows} with outstanding = opening + invoiced - paid, sorted desc; created invoice qty 2500 @ 16 = ₹47,200.00, partial payment ₹10,000, TN1001 outstanding = ₹37,200.00 verified; regression: reports daily/monthly, inventory, invoices, payments all 200). Frontend E2E: login OK; all 11 nav items present including new nav-collections; Collections page renders 3 stat cards, collections-table, collections-search-input, export-collections-button; TN1001 row shows Opening ₹0.00 / Invoiced ₹47,200.00 / Paid ₹10,000.00 / Outstanding ₹37,200.00 matching backend; collect-TN1001 navigates to /payments?shop=<id>; invoice detail page renders 'Download PDF' (data-testid download-invoice-pdf) — click triggered download of 'AP602.pdf' with zero JS/console errors; Reports Monthly tab: 'PDF' (download-monthly-pdf) triggered download of 'monthly-report-2026-09.pdf' with zero JS errors; 'CSV' button present. Layout footer 'Built by R I Billing Pro' still shown. No overlay/z-index/contrast issues detected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/overdue-nudge/run (line 917) awaits run_overdue_nudge() inline so request blocks ~1-2s while Resend email is sent. Consider BackgroundTasks like the cron variant. Non-blocking.
pdf.js downloadElementPdf: silently returns if element id not found (no error toast). If a user clicks Download PDF before content fully hydrated, they get no feedback. Minor UX.
pdf.js uses html2canvas single-shot capture and then slices across pages by negative y-offset — works but content on page boundaries may be split mid-row. Acceptable for MVP.
GET /api/collections loads all invoices/payments in memory (to_list(9000)); fine for 149 shops but should paginate/aggregate in DB if volume grows.
Collections.jsx has no loading state — before /collections resolves, all stat cards show ₹0.00 which could be mistaken for real data. Minor.
CORS still allow_credentials=True with allow_origins from env defaulting to '*' — same non-blocking spec violation as iteration_2.
